يستحصل (form X)

# يُسْتَحْصَلُ (yustaḥṣalu) /jus.taħ.sˤa.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَحْصَلَ (istaḥṣala)
# يَسْتَحْصِلَ (yastaḥṣila) /jas.taħ.sˤi.la/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَحْ
